thread.title_full: Saugus Man Arrested After Allegedly Pointing Gun At Wife - NewsBreak

author: Steven Barrera
title: Saugus Man Arrested After Allegedly Pointing Gun At Wife - NewsBreak
text:
By Steven Barrera ,
7 hours ago
A 75-year-old man was arrested in Saugus Wednesday evening after allegedly pointing a firearm at his wife and threatening to harm her during a domestic dispute, according to the Santa Clarita Valley Sheriff’s Station.
Roy Ramey was arrested on Oct. 28 at approximately 6:45 p.m. on suspicion of felony assault with a deadly weapon and criminal threats, according to Shirley Miller, a spokesperson for the Sheriff’s Station.
Deputies responded to a domestic violence-related call in the 33200 block of Wagon Wheel Road in Saugus, where they learned that Ramey and his wife had reportedly gotten into an argument that escalated.
During the incident, Ramey allegedly pointed a firearm at the victim and made threats to harm her, Miller said.
Ramey was also arrested for alleged domestic violence in June and November 2025, according to previous arrest record information.
